On the computer running OpenCode:

 1. Make it discoverable on your Wi-Fi:
 opencode web --mdns

 Or use a fixed port:
 opencode web --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096

 2. Set a password before starting (recommended):
 OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD=your-password

 3. Keep the phone on the same Wi-Fi and tap “Find on Wi-Fi”.

From anywhere (remote tunnel):
 1. Run: opencode pair --remote
 2. Scan the QR code, or paste the printed link.
 Pairing links work once and expire after 5 minutes.

Find the computer’s address:
 Windows: ipconfig
 macOS/Linux: ifconfig or ip addr

Notes:
 • The phone cannot use “localhost”: that means the phone itself.
 • OpenCode binds to 127.0.0.1 by default, so you must start it with --hostname 0.0.0.0 or --mdns.
 • WSL and Docker users must forward the port to the host machine.
 • mDNS discovery needs the computer and phone on the same network.
